fieldNotes.files[].sha256: Present only when the HF API (LFS) or GitHub release API exposed it. Small non-LFS files have no sha256 in the API; verify by size + pinned revision.
fieldNotes.files[].revision: HF commit sha the file list was read at; download with /resolve/<revision>/ to pin.
fieldNotes.files[].archive: Download is a tarball/zip that must be extracted; the runtime paths inside are listed in asr-models.md.
fieldNotes.publishedWer: Vendor/third-party numbers with different text normalization; not comparable across sources. Benchmark on device.
fieldNotes.hostEval: Measured by the asr-ocr spike on the x86_64 dev host, sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 Python (same C++ core as the Android JNI), ONNX Runtime CPU, 4 threads, shared server with load average 20-60 from other tenants: RTF is pessimistic and NOT a phone figure. Set: 12 FLEURS-dev + 1 pack clip per language. WER/CER after lowercasing and punctuation removal.
fieldNotes.qnnBinary: qairt = QAIRT/QNN SDK that compiled the context binaries (read from the binaries). A QNN runtime >= that version loads them; an older one does not.

languages.notes: 40 locales; 8 adaptation-ready locales need fine-tuning. Pass target language per stream (e.g. ru, en) or auto.

models.licenseNotes: Permissive; keep license + notices when redistributing; rights terminate if you sue over the model.
models.architecture: cache-aware FastConformer encoder + RNN-T, language-ID prompt
models.runtime: sherpa-onnx OnlineRecognizer, provider=qnn, model_type=nemo_transducer, 3 QNN context binaries (encoder.bin, decoder.bin, joiner.bin); needs a sherpa-onnx build with SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_QNN=ON (native/sherpa/build-android.sh); the official sherpa-onnx-2.0.1.aar has no QNN code
models.notes: Streaming works, but host CPU accuracy of the same weights is clearly below Parakeet v3 (FLEURS ru 13.9 / en 12.8 % WER vs 7.4 / 7.6) and auto language ID misfired (Russian clip -> Polish); inside one stream it does not follow ru<->en switches (mixed clip 33 % WER, Parakeet with VAD segments 4.5 %). Use as optional live preview, not as the text of record. GitHub-hosted.

auxiliary.notes: This asset is Silero VAD v4 (ONNX metadata: "silero-vad v4 exported to onnx by k2-fsa", inputs x/h/c). sherpa-onnx Vad accepts v4 and v5. Prefer silero-vad@onnx-v5.

Silero v5 layout (input/state/sr). Used by the asr-ocr segmentation prototype (VAD run with ONNX Runtime, 512-sample frames, thr 0.5 / neg 0.35). Same model family as silero-vad@onnx-v5, HF-hosted. VERIFIED with sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 VoiceActivityDetector on a 60 s clip (thr 0.5, min silence 0.5 s): silero_vad_v5.onnx and onnx-community/silero-vad give identical segments; the v4 asset gives the same 6 segments with boundaries within 0.2 s.
